payload.core_mechanism_summary: Iterates divisors i from max down to 2. For each i, lets m = count of array elements divisible by i. Then f[i] = (m * 2^(m-1) - sum_{j multiple of i} f[j]) % MOD. Adds i * f[i] to answer. DP on divisors to isolate subsets with exact gcd i.
payload.rationale: The solution computes the sum of subset sizes with exact gcd using a combinatorial DP on divisors (inclusion-exclusion). It counts combinations via powers of two and subtracts overcounts, fitting dp_counting_combinatorics.
